owner_calls.question: In X-Men: First Class, Moira takes Charles and Raven to CIA headquarters in Langley, Virginia (about 13 km outside Washington, D.C.), not inside the city. Keep the entry on the Washington, D.C. pin as part of the D.C. area (as the Pentagon entries already are on the foxtrn D.C. pin), or move it to its own Langley, Virginia place?
options: Keep on Washington, D.C. (D.C. area, like the Pentagon)
Move to a new 'CIA Headquarters, Langley, Virginia' place [38.95, -77.15]
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men Movies wiki, CIA Headquarters: 'In 1962, after locating Charles Xavier in Oxford, Moira MacTaggert brings him to the CIA's headquarters... located in Langley, Virginia'; Raven mimics Stryker Sr. there to prove mutants exist.
